title: Miracle flatness
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m_R)$ and $(S,\mathfrak m_S)$ be Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $\varphi:R\to S$ a local homomorphism ($\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)\subseteq\mathfrak m_S$). Assume (1) $R$ is a regular local ring [def-weil-regular-scheme]; (2) $S$ is Cohen–Macaulay: $\operatorname{depth}(S)\ge\dim(S)$ [def-weil-pbc-depth], $\dim$ the Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] (that is, $\mathfrak m_S$ contains an $S$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence] of length $\dim S$); (3) $\dim(S)=\dim(R)+\dim(S/\mathfrak m_RS)$, where $\mathfrak m_RS$ is the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(\mathfrak m_R)$. Then $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00R4 (lemma-CM-over-regular-flat, line 32654, slogan 'Miracle flatness')

proof.text: Choose a finite set s generating the source maximal ideal with cardinality its spanFinrank, using Mathlib Submodule.FG.exists_span_finset_card_eq_spanFinrank. The source is Noetherian, so its maximal ideal is finitely generated. Regularity identifies this cardinality d with ringKrullDim R. Turn s into a list x of length d; Ideal.ofList x is the maximal ideal.

Locality places every image of x in the target maximal ideal. Ideal.map_ofList identifies the ideal of x.map φ with the mapped source maximal ideal. The assumed additive dimension equality becomes dim(S/Ideal.ofList(x.map φ)) + length(x.map φ) = e, without truncated subtraction.

Apply RingTheory.Sequence.isRegular_of_dimension_drop with the target dimension e, its depth bound, the mapped list in the target maximal ideal, and the equality of the previous step. Thus x.map φ is an S-regular sequence.

Apply RingHom.flat_of_regular_parameters to φ, d, x, the source dimension equality, the length and generation equalities, and regularity of x.map φ. This gives φ.Flat. The same proof includes d=0, since the list is then empty.
